subject: science
skillName: Reducing Human Impact on Earth Systems

items.prompt:
A technology that reduces factory air pollution is
A) smoke filters (scrubbers)
B) more smokestacks
C) burning more coal
D) removing filters

A good solution is one that
A) reduces harm while being practical and affordable
B) costs the most
C) looks nicest
D) does nothing
items.answer: A) reduces harm while being practical and affordable

items.prompt:
To refine a solution means to
A) improve it based on how it performs
B) delete it
C) ignore results
D) make it worse
items.answer: A) improve it based on how it performs

items.prompt:
Replacing a coal plant with wind turbines
A) provides energy while reducing air pollution
B) increases air pollution
C) uses more coal
D) makes no energy
items.answer: A) provides energy while reducing air pollution

steps: Wind cuts pollution while giving energy.

items.prompt:
A pollution-reducing technology that uses too much energy could be refined by
A) using less energy or renewable energy
B) using even more energy
C) stopping the pollution reduction
D) removing it
items.answer: A) using less energy or renewable energy

items.prompt:
A technology to clean polluted water is a
A) water treatment plant
B) smokestack
C) coal mine
D) landfill

A recycling system that reduces waste but is hard to use is best refined by
A) making it easier so more people recycle
B) making it harder
C) removing collection points
D) stopping recycling
items.answer: A) making it easier so more people recycle

items.prompt:
Why evaluate a solution's affordability, not just its harm reduction?
A) A solution must be practical and affordable to actually be used
B) Cost never matters
C) Only looks matter
D) Harm reduction is unimportant
items.answer: A) A solution must be practical and affordable to actually be used
